domain.name: HAIQU Hospital Environment
domain.description: Entities and relationships needed to understand how hospital physical layout and air-handling infrastructure create the conditions for airborne pathogen movement and accumulation.
domain.guiding_question: How does hospital room configuration and HVAC design affect airborne pathogen distribution?
